findings.title: Confirmation across concealment and disclosure
findings.claim: In the pericope's opening sequence, confirming the good can be read as fidelity that remains aligned when visibility moves from concealment to disclosure.
findings.mechanism: The correspondence carried by صَدَّقَ and the goodness carried by ٱلْحُسْنَىٰ meet the supplied covering trace in 92:1 and disclosure trace in 92:2, turning one-time assent into an alignment tested across changing visibility.
findings.reader_payoff: The focus becomes a confirmation that endures through hidden and revealed phases, while its ordinary sense of affirming the good remains recoverable.
findings.containment: This is a qualified, attributed HFT reading. The supplied alternative is that 92:1-2 frame cosmic time without adding an epistemic test; no lexically independent context branch record or broader theological rule is asserted.

epistemic.reason: The focus branches are supplied and accepted, but the context branch records, target morphology, and HFT reader identity are legacy-unbound; the exact coordinate trace keeps the relation visible as attributed evidence rather than establishing it as ordinary lexical fact.
